name: CRM Contact Segment
description: Define named, reusable segments of CRM Contacts.
project_description: A thin target submodule of Entity Segment for the contrib CRM module. It ships the `crm_contact` segment type (target_entity_type_id: crm_contact) and a first-class Segments area under CRM at /crm/segments, so CRM Contacts become a targetable audience for email campaigns. drupal/crm (^1.0@beta) is a dependency of this submodule only, not of the base engine. All segment machinery lives in the base entity_segment module.
